_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), Series D3CBA/1 Set-1. 24 page images: idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions + Q1-2; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-22 (each odd index 3-21 is the Hindi of the page after it); idx 23 (folio 24) is BLANK, the cover announces 23 printed pages. Odd-page tops checked: all Hindi, including idx 13 which opens with the Hindi of Q25 (B) (its English sits at the top of idx 14). Printed instructions confirm sci80: 39 questions, A Q1-20 x1, B 21-26 x2, C 27-33 x3, D 34-36 x5, E 37-39 x4 (case-based); instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme for a bare OR: Q23, 25, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37(iii), 38(iii), 39(iii) = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. Case-study labels on this paper are (i)/(ii)/(iii)(A) OR (iii)(B). All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off the scheme page images (ms idx 2); each re-derived: 18 agree, Q9 disagrees (flagged), Q10 arguable (flagged). No void/'full marks to every attempt' note anywhere in the scheme. Decimal points on this paper are ordinary full stops (Q28: pH 4.6), although the scheme prints raised ones. Opener of series 31/1: nothing skipped.
